values: 將運行追蹤的追蹤網絡。 在使用企業級地理資料庫時，輸入追蹤網絡必須來自圖徵服務；不支持來自資料庫連接的追蹤網絡。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定要執行的追蹤類型。 已連接—將使用從一個或多個起點開始并沿著已連接圖徵向外跨越的已連接追蹤。 上游—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置上游的圖徵的上游追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 下游—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置下游的圖徵的下游追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 最短路徑—將使用可查找網絡中兩個起點之間的最短路徑（不考慮流向）的最短路徑追蹤。 遍歷路徑的成本取決于為最短路徑網絡屬性名稱參數設置的網絡屬性。 已連接—將使用從一個或多個起點開始并沿著已連接圖徵向外跨越的已連接追蹤。 上游—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置上游的圖徵的上溯追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 下游—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置下游的圖徵的下溯追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 最短路徑—將使用可查找網絡中兩個起點之間的最短路徑（不考慮流向）的最短路徑追蹤。 遍歷路徑的成本取決于為 shortest_path_network_attribute_name 參數設置的網絡屬性。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 使用追蹤位置窗格中的起點選項卡創建的圖徵圖層，或包含一個或多個表示追蹤起點的記錄的表或圖徵類。 在使用追蹤位置窗格中的起點工具創建起點時，默認情況下，將使用 TN_Temp_Starting_Points 圖徵類，并在工程的默認地理資料庫中生成該圖徵類。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 包含一個或多個圖徵，表示防止追蹤遍歷超出此點的追蹤障礙的表或圖徵類。 在使用追蹤位置窗格中的障礙選項卡創建障礙時，默認情況下，將使用 TN_Temp_Barriers 圖徵類，并在工程的默認地理資料庫中生成該圖徵類。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤路徑的方向。 遍歷路徑的成本取決于最短路徑網絡屬性名稱參數值。 僅當運行最短路徑追蹤類型時，才會使用此參數。 無方向—將使用兩個起點之間的路徑（無論流向為何）。 這是默認設置。 上游路徑—將使用兩個起點之間的上游路徑。 下游路徑—將使用兩個起點之間的下游路徑。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 最短路徑網絡屬性名稱 （可選）
用于計算路徑的網絡屬性的名稱。 運行最短路徑追蹤類型時，使用數字網絡屬性（例如形狀長度）計算最短路徑。 基于成本和距離的路徑都可以進行計算。 運行最短路徑追蹤時，需要此參數。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤結果中是否包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。 選中—追蹤結果中將包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。 這是默認設置。 未選中—追蹤結果中將不包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定如果在任何遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區是否返回錯誤。 這是保證追蹤通過網絡中狀態一致圖徵的唯一方法。 要移除臟區，請驗證網絡拓撲。 選中—如果在任何遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區，追蹤將返回錯誤。 這是默認設置。 未選中—無論是否在遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區，追蹤都將返回結果。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定是否在追蹤配置中忽略起點處的障礙。 選中—追蹤過程中將忽略起點處的障礙。 未選中—追蹤過程中不會忽略起點處的障礙。 這是默認設置。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定是否追蹤具有不確定或未初始化流向的圖徵。 此參數僅在運行上游追蹤或下游追蹤時使用。 選中—將追蹤具有不確定流向或未初始化流向的圖徵。 未選中—不會追蹤具有不確定流向或未初始化流向的圖徵。 這是默認設置。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 基于與網絡屬性的比較，對圖徵設置可遍歷性障礙條件。 條件障礙使用網絡屬性、運算符和類型以及屬性值。 例如，當圖徵的 Code 屬性等于 ArtificialPath 這一特定值時，將停止追蹤。 當圖徵滿足此條件時，追蹤將停止。 如果您要使用多個屬性，可使用組合方法參數來定義 And 或 Or 條件。 值表列： Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple condition barriers. And—Combine the condition barriers. Or—Use if either condition barrier is met.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 基于函數對圖徵設置可遍歷性障礙。 函數障礙可用于執行以下操作：限制追蹤距離起點的行程或設置停止追蹤的最大值。 例如，所經過的每條線的長度和為目前經過的總距離。 當經過的總長度達到指定值時，追蹤將停止。 值表列： Function—Filter by a function. Min—The minimum of the input values. Max—The maximum of the input values. Average—The average of the input values. Count—The number of features. Add—Add the values. Subtract—Subtract the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Value—Filter by a specific value. Use Local Values—Boolean value to use local variables instead of a global variable.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定將應用的可遍歷性類型。 可遍歷性范圍用于確定是否在交匯點和/或邊處應用可遍歷性。 例如，在游憩步道網絡中，如果條件障礙定義為當 SurfaceType 屬性包含值“gravel”并且可遍歷性范圍設置為僅交匯點時停止追蹤，則即使遇到 Surfacetype 欄位具有此值的邊圖徵，追蹤也不會停止，因為 Surfacetype 屬性僅適用于邊。 交匯點和邊—可遍歷性將同時應用于交匯點和邊。 這是默認設置。 僅交匯點—可遍歷性將僅應用于交匯點。 僅邊—可遍歷性將僅應用于邊。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 將應用于追蹤結果的計算函數。 值表列： Function—Filter by a function. Min—The minimum of the input values. Max—The maximum of the input values. Average—The average of the input values. Count—The number of features. Add—The sum of the values. Subtract—The difference between the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute Filter Name—Filter by attribute name. Filter Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Filter Type—Filter by attribute type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Filter Value—Filter by a specific value. Function Name—The name for the alias to describe the function result.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 根據網絡屬性返回的圖徵類型。 例如，如果將追蹤配置為“過濾掉除水龍頭圖徵外的所有圖徵”，那么未分配“水龍頭”屬性的追蹤圖徵均不會包含在結果中。 任何追蹤的圖徵都會返回到結果選擇集中。 值表列： Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple conditions. And—Combine the conditions. Or—Use if either condition is met.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤返回的結果的類型。 選擇—追蹤結果將作為相應網絡圖徵上的選擇集返回。 這是默認設置。 聚合幾何—追蹤結果按幾何類型聚合，并存儲在活動地圖的圖層中顯示的圖徵類中。 網絡圖層—追蹤結果將被作為圖層組內的選擇集添加到圖徵圖層。 連通性—追蹤結果將作為指定輸出 .json 文件中的連通圖返回。 此選項將啟用輸出 JSON 參數。 元素—追蹤結果將作為指定輸出 .json 文件中的基于圖徵的信息返回。 此選項將啟用輸出 JSON 參數。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定如何應用所選內容以及如果已存在當前內容要執行的操作。 新建選擇內容—生成的選擇內容將替換當前選擇內容。 這是默認設置。 添加到當前選擇內容—當存在一個選擇內容時，會將生成的選擇內容添加到當前選擇內容中。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項的作用與新選擇內容選項的作用相同。 從當前選擇內容中移除—將生成的選擇內容從當前選擇內容中移除。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項不起作用。 選擇當前選擇內容的子集—將生成的選擇內容與當前選擇內容進行組合。 僅兩者共有的記錄保持選中狀態。 切換當前選擇內容—生成的選擇內容將被切換。 將所選的結果從當前選擇內容中移除，同時將未選取的結果添加到當前選擇內容中。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項的作用與新選擇內容選項的作用相同。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 清除所有之前的追蹤結果 （可選）
指定將內容從選定用來存儲聚合幾何的圖徵類中截斷，還是追加到該圖徵類中。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。 選中—將截斷用于存儲聚合追蹤幾何的圖徵類。 將僅寫入當前追蹤操作的輸出幾何。 這是默認設置。 未選中—當前追蹤操作的輸出幾何將追加到用于存儲聚合幾何的圖徵類。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 追蹤操作的名稱。 此值將存儲在輸出圖徵類的 TRACENAME 欄位中，以協助識別追蹤結果。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 包含聚合結果幾何的輸出多點圖徵類。 默認情況下，將使用名為 Trace_Results_Aggregated_Points 的系統生成圖徵類填充該參數，該圖徵類將存儲在工程的默認地理資料庫中。 如果該圖徵類不存在，則系統會自動創建。 也可以使用現有圖徵類存儲聚合幾何。 如果使用非默認圖徵類，則該圖徵類必須是多點圖徵類，并且包含名為 TRACENAME 的字符串欄位。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 包含聚合結果幾何的輸出折線圖徵類。 默認情況下，將使用名為 Trace_Results_Aggregated_Lines 的系統生成圖徵類填充該參數，該圖徵類將存儲在工程的默認地理資料庫中。 如果該圖徵類不存在，則系統會自動創建。 也可以使用現有圖徵類存儲聚合幾何。 如果使用非默認圖徵類，則該圖徵類必須是折線圖徵類，并且包含名為 TRACENAME 的字符串欄位。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 將運行追蹤的追蹤網絡。 在使用企業級地理資料庫時，輸入追蹤網絡必須來自圖徵服務；不支持來自資料庫連接的追蹤網絡。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定要執行的追蹤的類型。 CONNECTED—將使用從一個或多個起點開始并沿著已連接圖徵向外跨越的已連接追蹤。 UPSTREAM—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置上游的圖徵的上溯追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 DOWNSTREAM—將使用能夠發現網絡中某位置下游的圖徵的下溯追蹤。 這種類型的追蹤需要設置流向。 SHORTEST_PATH—將使用可查找網絡中兩個起點之間的最短路徑（不考慮流向）的最短路徑追蹤。 遍歷路徑的成本取決于為 shortest_path_network_attribute_name 參數設置的網絡屬性。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 使用追蹤位置窗格中的起點選項卡創建的圖徵圖層，或包含一個或多個表示追蹤起點的記錄的表或圖徵類。 在使用追蹤位置窗格中的起點工具創建起點時，默認情況下，將使用 TN_Temp_Starting_Points 圖徵類，并在工程的默認地理資料庫中生成該圖徵類。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 包含一個或多個圖徵，表示防止追蹤遍歷超出此點的追蹤障礙的表或圖徵類。 在使用追蹤位置窗格中的障礙選項卡創建障礙時，默認情況下，將使用 TN_Temp_Barriers 圖徵類，并在工程的默認地理資料庫中生成該圖徵類。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤路徑的方向。 遍歷路徑的成本取決于 shortest_path_network_attribute_name 參數值。 此參數僅在運行 SHORTEST_PATH 追蹤類型時使用。 NO_DIRECTION—將使用兩個起點之間的路徑（無論流向為何）。 這是默認設置。 PATH_UPSTREAM—將使用兩個起點之間的上游路徑。 PATH_DOWNSTREAM—將使用兩個起點之間的下游路徑。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 用于計算路徑的網絡屬性的名稱。 運行最短路徑追蹤類型時，使用數字網絡屬性（例如形狀長度）計算最短路徑。 基于成本和距離的路徑都可以進行計算。 運行最短路徑追蹤時，需要此參數。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤結果中是否包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。 INCLUDE_BARRIERS—追蹤結果中將包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。 這是默認設置。 EXCLUDE_BARRIERS—追蹤結果中將不包含可遍歷性障礙圖徵。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定如果在任何遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區是否返回錯誤。 這是保證追蹤通過網絡中狀態一致圖徵的唯一方法。 要移除臟區，請驗證網絡拓撲。 VALIDATE_CONSISTENCY—如果在任何遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區，追蹤將返回錯誤。 這是默認設置。 DO_NOT_VALIDATE_CONSISTENCY—無論是否在遍歷的圖徵中遇到臟區，追蹤都將返回結果。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定是否在追蹤配置中忽略起點處的障礙。 IGNORE_BARRIERS_AT_STARTING_POINTS—追蹤過程中將忽略起點處的障礙。 DO_NOT_IGNORE_BARRIERS_AT_STARTING_POINTS—追蹤過程中不會忽略起點處的障礙。 這是默認設置。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定是否追蹤具有不確定或未初始化流向的圖徵。 此參數僅在運行上游追蹤或下游追蹤時使用。 TRACE_INDETERMINATE_FLOW—將追蹤具有不確定流向或未初始化流向的圖徵。 IGNORE_INDETERMINATE_FLOW—不會追蹤具有不確定流向或未初始化流向的圖徵。 這是默認設置。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: condition_barriers [Name, Operator, Type, Value, Combine Using,...] （可選）

基于與網絡屬性的比較，對圖徵設置可遍歷性障礙條件。 條件障礙使用網絡屬性、運算符和類型以及屬性值。 例如，當圖徵的 Code 屬性等于 ArtificialPath 這一特定值時，將停止追蹤。 當圖徵滿足此條件時，追蹤將停止。 如果要使用多個屬性，可使用 Combine Using 組件來定義 And 或 Or 條件。 值表列： Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. IS_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is equal to the value. DOES_NOT_EQUAL—The attribute is not equal to the value. IS_GREATER_THAN—The attribute is greater than the value. IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. IS_LESS_THAN—The attribute is less than the value. IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. SPECIFIC_VALUE—Filter by a specific value. NETWORK_ATTRIBUTE—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple condition barriers. AND—Combine the condition barriers. OR—Use if either condition barrier is met.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: function_barriers [Function, Attribute, Operator, Value, Use Local Values,...] （可選）

基于函數對圖徵設置可遍歷性障礙。 函數障礙可用于執行以下操作：限制追蹤距離起點的行程或設置停止追蹤的最大值。 例如，所經過的每條線的長度和為目前經過的總距離。 當經過的總長度達到指定值時，追蹤將停止。 值表列： Function—Filter by a function. MIN—The minimum of the input values. MAX—The maximum of the input values. AVERAGE—The average of the input values. COUNT—The number of features. ADD—Add the values. SUBTRACT—Subtract the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Operator—Filter by an operator. IS_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is equal to the value. DOES_NOT_EQUAL—The attribute is not equal to the value. IS_GREATER_THAN—The attribute is greater than the value. IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. IS_LESS_THAN—The attribute is less than the value. IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Value—Filter by a specific value. Use Local Values—Boolean value to use local variables instead of a global variable.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定將應用的可遍歷性類型。 可遍歷性范圍用于確定是否在交匯點和/或邊處應用可遍歷性。 例如，在游憩步道網絡中，如果條件障礙定義為當路徑類型為“礫石”并且可遍歷性范圍設置為僅交匯點時停止追蹤，則即使遇到礫石路徑，追蹤也不會停止，因為該路徑類型僅適用于邊。 BOTH_JUNCTIONS_AND_EDGES—可遍歷性將同時應用于交匯點和邊。 這是默認設置。 JUNCTIONS_ONLY—可遍歷性將僅應用于交匯點。 EDGES_ONLY—可遍歷性將僅應用于邊。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: functions [[Function, Attribute, Filter Name, Filter Operator, Filter Type, Filter Value, Function Name],...] （可選）

將應用于追蹤結果的計算函數。 值表列： Function—Filter by a function. MIN—The minimum of the input values. MAX—The maximum of the input values. AVERAGE—The average of the input values. COUNT—The number of features. ADD—The sum of the values. SUBTRACT—The difference between the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute Filter Name—Filter by attribute name. Filter Operator—Filter by an operator. IS_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is equal to the value. DOES_NOT_EQUAL—The attribute is not equal to the value. IS_GREATER_THAN—The attribute is greater than the value. IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. IS_LESS_THAN—The attribute is less than the value. IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Filter Type—Filter by attribute type. SPECIFIC_VALUE—Filter by a specific value. NETWORK_ATTRIBUTE—Filter by a network attribute. Filter Value—Filter by a specific value. Function Name—The name for the alias to describe the function result.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: output_conditions [[Name, Operator, Type, Value, Combine Using],...] （可選）

根據網絡屬性返回的圖徵類型。 例如，如果將追蹤配置為“過濾掉除水龍頭圖徵外的所有圖徵”，那么未分配“水龍頭”屬性的追蹤圖徵均不會包含在結果中。 任何追蹤的圖徵都會返回到結果選擇集中。 如果要使用多個屬性，可使用 Combine Using 選項來定義 And 或 Or 條件。 值表列： Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. IS_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is equal to the value. DOES_NOT_EQUAL—The attribute is not equal to the value. IS_GREATER_THAN—The attribute is greater than the value. IS_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. IS_LESS_THAN—The attribute is less than the value. IS_LESS_THAN_OR_EQUAL_TO—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. SPECIFIC_VALUE—Filter by a specific value. NETWORK_ATTRIBUTE—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple conditions. AND—Combine the conditions. OR—Use if either condition is met.

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定追蹤返回的結果的類型。 SELECTION—追蹤結果將作為相應網絡圖徵上的選擇集返回。 這是默認設置。 AGGREGATED_GEOMETRY—追蹤結果按幾何類型聚合，并存儲在活動地圖的圖層中顯示的圖徵類中。 NETWORK_LAYERS—追蹤結果將被作為圖層組內的選擇集添加到圖徵圖層。 CONNECTIVITY—追蹤結果將作為指定輸出 .json 文件中的連通圖返回。 此選項將啟用 out_json_file 參數。 ELEMENTS—追蹤結果將作為指定輸出 .json 文件中的圖徵元素返回。 此選項將啟用 out_json_file 參數。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定如何應用所選內容以及如果已存在當前內容要執行的操作。 NEW_SELECTION—生成的選擇內容將替換當前選擇內容。 這是默認設置。 ADD_TO_SELECTION—當存在一個選擇內容時，會將生成的選擇內容添加到當前選擇內容中。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項的作用與新選擇內容選項的作用相同。 REMOVE_FROM_SELECTION—將生成的選擇內容從當前選擇內容中移除。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項不起作用。 SUBSET_SELECTION—將生成的選擇內容與當前選擇內容進行組合。 僅兩者共有的記錄保持選中狀態。 SWITCH_SELECTION—生成的選擇內容將被切換。 將所選的結果從當前選擇內容中移除，同時將未選取的結果添加到當前選擇內容中。 如果不存在選擇內容，該選項的作用與新選擇內容選項的作用相同。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
values: 指定將內容從選定用來存儲聚合幾何的圖徵類中截斷，還是追加到該圖徵類中。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。 CLEAR_ALL_PREVIOUS_TRACE_RESULTS—將截斷用于存儲聚合追蹤幾何的圖徵類。 將僅寫入當前追蹤操作的輸出幾何。 這是默認設置。 DO_NOT_CLEAR_ALL_PREVIOUS_TRACE_RESULTS—當前追蹤操作的輸出幾何將追加到用于存儲聚合幾何的圖徵類。

values: 追蹤操作的名稱。 此值將存儲在輸出圖徵類的 TRACENAME 欄位中，以協助識別追蹤結果。 此參數僅適用于聚合幾何結果類型。

values: 輸出圖層組的名稱，其中包含具有由追蹤返回的圖徵選擇集的圖徵圖層。 該圖層將提供在 ModelBuilder 和 Python 中使用追蹤輸出的訪問權限。 此參數僅適用于網絡圖層結果類型。

text:
Trace 示例（Python 窗口）
在名為 HydroNetwork 的追蹤網絡上運行下游追蹤，以返回距離起點 500 米范圍內的圖徵。 由此將返回一個使用網絡圖層結果類型進行選擇的圖層組結果。

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
text:
'''****************************************************************************
Name:        UpstreamTrace.py
Description: This script runs an upstream trace in a trace network from a 
             specified starting point to return the total length of the 
             features using the network layers result type.
Created by:  Esri
****************************************************************************'''

# Import required modules
import arcpy

# Set local variables
in_trace_network = "Hydro Network"
trace_type = "UPSTREAM"
starting_points = "C:\\MyProject\\HydroTN.gdb\\TN_Temp_Starting_Points"
barriers = "C:\\MyProject\\HydroTN.gdb\\TN_Temp_Barriers"
path_direction = "NO_DIRECTION"
include_barriers = "INCLUDE_BARRIERS"
functions = "ADD 'Shape length' # # # # 'Total Length (Meters)'"
result_types = "NETWORK_LAYERS"
out_network_layer = "My_Trace_Result"

# Run Trace with specified parameters and leave the rest default
arcpy.tn.Trace(in_trace_network,
               trace_type,
               starting_points,
               barriers,
               path_direction,
               include_barriers,
               functions,
               result_types,
               out_network_layer)

topic: 追蹤 (追蹤網絡工具)
steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Trace，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸入追蹤網絡 [in_trace_network]、追蹤類型 [trace_type]、起點 [starting_points]、障礙 （可選） [barriers]、路徑方向 （可選） [path_direction]、最短路徑網絡屬性名稱 （可選） [shortest_path_network_attribute_name]、包括障礙圖徵 （可選） [include_barriers]、驗證一致性 （可選） [validate_consistency]、忽略起點處障礙 （可選） [ignore_barriers_at_starting_points]、允許不確定的流 （可選） [allow_indeterminate_flow]、條件障礙 （可選） [condition_barriers]、函數障礙 （可選） [function_barriers]、應用可遍歷性至 （可選） [traversability_scope]、函數 （可選） [functions]、輸出條件 （可選） [output_conditions]、結果類型 （可選） [result_types]、選擇內容類型 [selection_type]、清除所有之前的追蹤結果 （可選） [clear_all_previous_trace_results]、追蹤名稱 （可選） [trace_name]、聚合的點 （可選） [aggregated_points]、聚合的線 （可選） [aggregated_lines]、輸出圖層組名稱 （可選） [out_network_layer]、使用追蹤配置 （可選） [use_trace_config]、追蹤配置名稱 （可選） [trace_config_name]、輸出 JSON （可選） [out_json_file]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The trace network on which the trace will be run. When working with an enterprise geodatabase, an input trace network must be from a feature service; a trace network from a database connection is not supported.

Specifies the type of trace to execute. Connected—A connected trace that begins at one or more starting points and spans outward along connected features will be used. Upstream—An upstream trace that discovers features upstream from a location in the network will be used. This type of trace requires the flow direction to be set. Downstream—A downstream trace that discovers features downstream from a location in the network will be used. This type of trace requires the flow direction to be set. Shortest path—A shortest path trace that finds the shortest path between two starting points in the network regardless of flow direction will be used. The cost of traversing the path is determined based on the network attribute set for the Shortest Path Network Attribute Name parameter. Connected—A connected trace that begins at one or more starting points and spans outward along connected features will be used. Upstream—An upstream trace that discovers features upstream from a location in the network will be used. This type of trace requires the flow direction to be set. Downstream—A downstream trace that discovers features downstream from a location in the network will be used. This type of trace requires the flow direction to be set. Shortest path—A shortest path trace that finds the shortest path between two starting points in the network regardless of flow direction will be used. The cost of traversing the path is determined based on the network attribute set for the shortest_path_network_attribute_name parameter.

A feature layer created using the Starting Points tab in the Trace Locations pane, or a table or feature class containing one or more records that represent the starting points of the trace. The TN_Temp_Starting_Points feature class is used by default and is generated in the default geodatabase of the project when you create starting points using the Starting Points tool in the Trace Locations pane.

A table or feature class containing one or more features that represent the barriers of the trace that prevent the trace from traversing beyond that point. The TN_Temp_Barriers feature class is used by default and is generated in the default geodatabase of the project when you create barriers using the Barriers tab in the Trace Locations pane.

Specifies the direction of the trace path. The cost of traversing the path is determined by the Shortest Path Network Attribute Name parameter value. This parameter is only honored when running a Shortest path trace type. No direction—The path between the two starting points, regardless of the direction of flow, will be used. This is the default. Upstream path—The upstream path between the two starting points will be used. Downstream path—The downstream path between the two starting points will be used.

parameters.label_zh: 最短路徑網絡屬性名稱 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The name of the network attribute used to calculate the path. When running a shortest path trace type, the shortest path is calculated using a numeric network attribute such as shape length. Cost and distance based paths can both be achieved. This parameter is required when running a shortest path trace.

Specifies whether the traversability barrier features will be included in the trace results. Checked—Traversability barrier features will be included in the trace results. This is the default. Unchecked—Traversability barrier features will not be included in the trace results.

Specifies whether an error will be returned if dirty areas are encountered for any of the returned features. This is the only way to guarantee a trace is passing through features with consistent status in the network. To remove dirty areas, validate the network topology. Checked—The trace will return an error if any of the trace result has corresponding dirty areas, and select the corresponding features for you to investigate or validate. Unchecked—The trace will return results regardless of whether the trace result has corresponding dirty areas. This is the default.

Specifies whether barriers in the trace configuration will be ignored for starting points. Checked—Barriers at starting points will be ignored in the trace. Unchecked—Barriers at starting points will not be ignored in the trace. This is the default.

Specifies whether features with indeterminate or uninitialized flow will be traced. This parameter is only honored when running an upstream or downstream trace. Checked—Features with indeterminate or uninitialized flow direction will be traced. Unchecked—Features with indeterminate or uninitialized flow direction will not be traced. This is the default.

Sets a traversability barrier condition on features based on a comparison to a network attribute. A condition barrier uses a network attribute, an operator and a type, and an attribute value. For example, stop a trace when a feature has the Code attribute equal to the specific value of ArtificialPath. When a feature meets this condition, the trace stops. If you're using more than one attribute, you can use the Combine Using parameter to define an And or an Or condition. Value table columns: Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple condition barriers. And—Combine the condition barriers. Or—Use if either condition barrier is met.

Sets a traversability barrier on features based on a function. Function barriers can be used, for example, to restrict how far the trace travels from the starting point or to set a maximum value to stop a trace. For example, the length of each line traveled is added to the total distance traveled so far. When the total length traveled reaches the value specified, the trace stops. Value table columns: Function—Filter by a function. Min—The minimum of the input values. Max—The maximum of the input values. Average—The average of the input values. Count—The number of features. Add—Add the values. Subtract—Subtract the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Value—Filter by a specific value. Use local values—Boolean value to use local variables instead of a global variable.

Specifies the type of traversability that will be applied. Traversability scope determines whether traversability is applied to junctions, edges, or both. For example, in a network of recreational trails, if a condition barrier is defined to stop a trace if a surfacetype attribute contains a value of gravel and the traversability scope is set to junctions only, the trace will not stop even if it encounters an edge feature with this value in the surfacetype field, because the surfacetype attribute is only applicable to edges. Both junctions and edges—Traversability will be applied to both junctions and edges. This is the default. Junctions only—Traversability will be applied to junctions only. Edges only—Traversability will be applied to edges only.

The calculation function or functions that will be applied to the trace results. Value table columns: Function—Filter by a function. Min—The minimum of the input values. Max—The maximum of the input values. Average—The average of the input values. Count—The number of features. Add—The sum of the values. Subtract—The difference between the values. Attribute—Filter by a network attribute Filter Name—Filter by attribute name. Filter Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Filter Type—Filter by attribute type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Filter Value—Filter by a specific value. Function Name—The name for the alias to describe the function result.

The types of features that will be returned based on a network attribute. For example, in a trace configured to filter out everything but Tap features, any traced features that do not have the Tap attribute assigned to them are not included in the results. Any traced features that do are returned in the result selection set. Value table columns: Name—Filter by network attribute name. Operator—Filter by an operator. Is equal to—The attribute is equal to the value. Does not equal—The attribute is not equal to the value. Is greater than—The attribute is greater than the value. Is greater than or equal to—The attribute is greater than or equal to the value. Is less than—The attribute is less than the value. Is less than or equal to—The attribute is less than or equal to the value. Type—Filter by a specific type. Specific value—Filter by a specific value. Network attribute—Filter by a network attribute. Value—Filter by a specific value. Combine Using—Combine multiple conditions. And—Combine the conditions. Or—Use if either condition is met.

Specifies the type of results that will be returned by the trace. Selection—The trace results will be returned as a selection set on the appropriate network features. This is the default. Aggregated Geometry—The trace results will be aggregated by geometry type and stored in feature classes displayed in layers in the active map. Network Layers—The trace results will be added to feature layers as a selection set in a group layer. Connectivity—The trace results will be returned as a connectivity graph in a specified output .json file. This option enables the Output JSON parameter. Elements—The trace results will be returned as feature-based information in a specified output .json file. This option enables the Output JSON parameter.

Specifies how the selection will be applied and what to do if a current selection exists. New selection—The resulting selection will replace the current selection. This is the default. Add to the current selection—The resulting selection will be added to the current selection if one exists. If no selection exists, this is the same as the new selection option. Remove from the current selection—The resulting selection will be removed from the current selection. If no selection exists, this option has no effect. Select subset from the current selection—The resulting selection will be combined with the current selection. Only records that are common to both remain selected. Switch the current selection—The resulting selection will be switched. Results that were selected are removed from the current selection, while results that were not selected are added to the current selection. If no selection exists, this is the same as the new selection option.

parameters.label_zh: 清除所有之前的追蹤結果 （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether content will be truncated from or appended to the feature classes chosen to store aggregated geometry. This parameter is only applicable to the aggregated geometry result type. Checked—The feature classes storing aggregated trace geometry will be truncated. Only the output geometry from the current trace operation will be written. This is the default. Unchecked—The output geometry from the current trace operation will be appended to the feature classes storing aggregated geometry.

The name of the trace operation. This value is stored in the TRACENAME field of the output feature class to assist with identification of the trace results. This parameter is only applicable to the aggregated geometry result type.

An output multipoint feature class that contains the aggregated result geometry. By default, the parameter value will be Trace_Results_Aggregated_Points stored in the project's default geodatabase. The tool creates this feature class if it does not exist. You can also use an existing feature class to store the aggregated geometry. If a feature class other than the default is used, it must be a point feature class and contain a string field named TRACENAME. To exclude an aggregated point layer from the trace results, clear the parameter's default value. This parameter is only applicable to the Result Types parameter's Aggregated Geometry option.

An output polyline feature class that contains the aggregated result geometry. By default, the parameter value will be Trace_Results_Aggregated_Lines stored in the project's default geodatabase. The tool creates this feature class if it does not exist. You can also use an existing feature class to store the aggregated geometry. If a feature class other than the default is used, it must be a polyline feature class and contain a string field named TRACENAME. To exclude an aggregated line layer from the trace results, remove the default value from the Aggregated Lines parameter. This parameter is only applicable to the Result Types parameter's Aggregated Geometry option.

The name of the output group layer that contains feature layers with selection sets of features returned by the trace. The layer provides access to work with the output of a trace in ModelBuilder and Python. This parameter is only applicable to the network layers result type.

Specifies whether an existing named trace configuration will be used to populate the parameters of the Trace tool. Checked—An existing named trace configuration will be used to define the properties of the trace. All parameters except Trace Configuration Name, Starting Points, and Barriers will be ignored. Unchecked—An existing named trace configuration will not be used to define the properties of the trace. This is the default.
The name of the trace configuration that will be used to define the properties of the trace. This parameter is only active when the Use Trace Configuration parameter is checked.
The name and location of the .json file that will be generated.

# Name: NeighborhoodSelection_Example_02.py
# Description: Creates a layer of points based on a user-defined neighborhood.
# Requirements: Geostatistical Analyst extension

# Import system modules
import arcpy

# Set environment settings
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/gapyexamples/data"

# Set local variables
inPoints = "ca_ozone_pts.shp"
outLayer = "outNS"
pointCoord = "-2000000 -50000"
maxNeighbors = 20
minNeighbors = 5
majSemiaxis = 200000
minSemiaxis = 200000
angle = 0
shape = "One Sector"

# Run NeighborhoodSelection
arcpy.ga.GANeighborhoodSelection(inPoints, outLayer, pointCoord, maxNeighbors,
                                 minNeighbors, majSemiaxis, minSemiaxis, angle,
                                 shape)

topic: Generate Elevation Bands From Features (Topographic Production Tools)
text: Generates band features that represent elevation levels on a map product. The tool can be run with set values from standardized product specifications or with custom-defined values.

topic: Generate Elevation Bands From Features (Topographic Production Tools)
text:
The Area of Interest layer must have only one feature selected.
The Area of Interest parameter value should be rectangle or square geometry. The tool may create incorrect bands if geometry other than rectangle or square is used.
Use a Contour Features parameter value that has been collected using meters or feet.
The Output Feature Class parameter value will contain the following fields: Low_Value High_Value TintBand If the feature class already exists, ensure that these fields do too.
ArcGIS Pro JOG, TPC, and ONC database product files have been updated with the appropriate fields. The BM datasets are JOG_BANDS_A, TPC_BANDS_A, and ONC_BANDS_A, respectively.
You can specify a Band Interval parameter value to create bands at regular intervals, such as every 500 meters, or you can specify irregular intervals, but not both. If a Band Interval parameter value is specified, the Band Values parameter will be inactive.

topic: Generate Elevation Bands From Features (Topographic Production Tools)
text:
If a standard product such as JOG-A, TPC, or ONC is specified for the Product parameter, the standard ranges defined by the product specification will be automatically populated for the Band Values parameter. Bands can be added or removed as required.
If Custom is specified for the Product parameter, the Band Values parameter values must also be provided.
If a band interval is specified, the resulting band polygons will be created based on the interval, starting with 0. For example, if the input contours are in meters and the value for the Band Interval parameter is 500, the output bands will be created from 0 to 500 meters, then 500 to 1,000 meters, and so on.
If the band values specified do not fully cover the range of elevations in the selected Area of Interest (AOI), no bands will be created over those areas. For example, if Band 1 is defined as 500 to 750 meters and Band 2 is defined as 750 to 1250 meters, but the elevation range in the specified AOI is 300 to 1500 meters, no elevation bands will be created for contour-bounded areas less than 500 meters or greater than 1250 meters.

topic: Generate Elevation Bands From Features (Topographic Production Tools)
text:
The specified Band Interval parameter value or the resulting interval from specifying Low and High values for the Band Values parameter, must be divisible by the contour interval to ensure that the Output Feature Class parameter value isn't missing bands.
The generated bands will cover the extent of both the Contour Features and Exclusion Features parameter values to avoid gaps. If the Exclusion Features parameter value is not specified, the extent of the contour lines will set the bounds of the generated bands.
Ensure that contours cover the entire AOI specified in the Area of Interest parameter. Open contour lines must extend up to or beyond the specified AOI.
Remove any intersecting contour lines from the Contour Features parameter value before running the tool; otherwise, the tool will report an error.
The contour lines specified for the Contour Features parameter should be continuous. Use the Merge Lines By Pseudo Node tool to merge line features with matching attribute values.

text:
GenerateElevationBandsFromFeatures example (stand-alone script)
The following code sample demonstrates how to use the GenerateElevationBandsFromFeatures function.

topic: Generate Elevation Bands From Features (Topographic Production Tools)
text:
# Name: GenerateElevationBandsFromFeatures_sample.py
# Description: Generates band features used to represent different elevation levels on a JOG-A product.

# Import System Modules
import arcpy

# Setting the environment
arcpy.env.overwriteOutput = True

# Make Feature Layer for Area of Interest
arcpy.management.MakeFeatureLayer(r'C:\Users\Public\Documents\ArcGIS Topographic Mapping\Product Files\2.9\ReferenceData\MapIndex.gdb\Reference\GRID_1_DEGREE', 'JOG_Layer')

# Select Area of Interest Feature
arcpy.management.SelectLayerByAttribute('JOG_Layer', 'NEW_SELECTION', "CID = '34N120W'")

# Setting Local Variables
contour_features = r'C:\Data\JOG.gdb\BM\HypsographyCrv'
elevation_field = 'ZVH'
area_of_interest = 'JOG_Layer'
out_feature_class = r'C:\Data\JOG.gdb\BM\JOG_BANDS_A'
exclusion_features = r'C:\Data\JOG.gdb\BM\HydrographySrf'
product = 'JOG-A'
band_interval = ''
band_values = '0 1315;1315 1970;1970 5250;5250 9190;9190 12470;12470 29200'

# Use the Generate Elevation Bands From Features tool to generate band features for JOG-A product
arcpy.topographic.GenerateElevationBandsFromFeatures(contour_features, elevation_field, area_of_interest, out_feature_class, exclusion_features, product, band_interval, band_values)

topic: 計算面的主角度 (制圖工具)
text: 用于計算輸入面圖徵的主角度并將值分配給欄位以用于定向符號系統，例如面內的標記或影線。

topic: 計算面的主角度 (制圖工具)
text:
面的主角度是指一組具有相似方向且總長度最長的線段的角度。 出于符號旋轉的目的，當主角度為水平時，會將面視為垂直定向。 將記錄垂直于面主角度的角度，因為這會在使用符號旋轉的值時形成預期方向。
從旋轉方法的原點開始，以十進制度將垂直于面主角度的角度存儲在指定欄位中。
此工具主要適用于正交面，而非有機形狀面。

帶有顯示金字塔的 LAS 資料集在 2.6 之前的 ArcGIS Pro 版本中不受支持。 移除金字塔將可以在之前的軟件版本中使用 LAS 資料集。 可使用此工具刪除金字塔，以允許這些應用程序使用 LAS 資料集。 但是，首選做法是為這些應用程序創建新的 LAS 資料集，因為生成顯示金字塔的處理時間明顯比創建新的 LAS 資料集的時間長。 可以通過指定現有 LAS 資料集作為輸入，而使用顯示金字塔將文件引用從 LAS 資料集添加到新的 LAS 資料集。 如果要使用其他金字塔點選擇方法，僅考慮刪除顯示金字塔。

topic: 從 LAS 資料集移除文件 (資料管理工具)
text:
'''*********************************************************************
Name: Modify Files in LAS Dataset& Calculate Stats for LASD
Description: Adds files & surface constraints to a LAS dataset, then
             calculates statistics and generates report.
*********************************************************************'''
# Import system modules
import arcpy

try:
    # Script variables
    arcpy.env.workspace = 'C:/data'
    lasd = 'sample.lasd'
    oldLas = ['2006', '2007/file2.las']
    newLas = ['2007_updates_1', '2007_updates_2']
    oldSurfaceConstraints = ['boundary.shp', 'streams.shp']
    newSurfaceConstraints = [['sample.gdb/boundary', '<None>',
                              'Soft_Clip']
                             ['sample.gdb/streams', 'Shape.Z',
                              'Hard_Line']]
    arcpy.management.RemoveFilesFromLasDataset(lasd, oldLas,
                                               oldSurfaceConstraints)
    arcpy.management.AddFilesToLasDataset(lasd, newLas, 'RECURSION',
                                          newSurfaceConstraints)
    arcpy.management.LasDatasetStatistics(lasd, "UPDATED_FILES",
                                          "lasd_stats.txt",
                                          "LAS_FILE", "DECIMAL_POINT",
                                          "SPACE", "LAS_summary.txt")
except arcpy.ExecuteError:
    print(arcpy.GetMessages())
except Exception as err:
    print(err.args[0])

topic: 反距離權重法 (地統計分析工具)
text:
使用反距離權重插值法，依據預測位置周邊的測量值預測任意未采樣位置處的數值。 此工具假設彼此距離較近的事物要比彼此距離較遠的事物更相似。
了解有關反距離權重法工作原理的詳細信息

topic: 反距離權重法 (地統計分析工具)
text:
預測值將被限制在用于插值的值的范圍內。 因為反距離權重插值法是加權平均距離，所以該平均值不可能大于輸入資料最大值或小于輸入資料最小值。 例如，如果尚未對山脊頂部或山谷底部進行采樣，該方法將無法準確預測山脊或山谷。
反距離權重插值法可能在資料點周邊近距離范圍內生成環形等值線（此現象常稱為牛眼效應）。
與其他插值方法（例如克里金法）不同，反距離權重插值法不會對輸入資料的統計屬性做出明確的假設。 當輸入資料不滿足更高級插值方法的統計假設時，通常會使用反距離權重插值法。

# Name: InverseDistanceWeighting_Example_02.py
# Description: Interpolate a series of point features onto a rectangular raster
#              using Inverse Distance Weighting (IDW).
# Requirements: Geostatistical Analyst extension

# Import system modules
import arcpy

# Set environment settings
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/gapyexamples/data"

# Set local variables
inPointFeatures = "ca_ozone_pts.shp"
zField = "OZONE"
outLayer = "outIDW"
outRaster = "C:/gapyexamples/output/idwout"
cellSize = 2000.0
power = 2

# Set variables for search neighborhood
majSemiaxis = 300000
minSemiaxis = 300000
angle = 0
maxNeighbors = 15
minNeighbors = 10
sectorType = "ONE_SECTOR"
searchNeighbourhood = arcpy.SearchNeighborhoodStandard(majSemiaxis, minSemiaxis,
                                                       angle, maxNeighbors,
                                                       minNeighbors, sectorType)

# Run IDW
arcpy.ga.IDW(inPointFeatures, zField, outLayer, outRaster, cellSize,
             power, searchNeighbourhood)

parameters.description_en: The input point features containing the z-values to be interpolated.
Field that holds a height or magnitude value for each point. This can be a numeric field or the Shape field if the input features contain z-values or m-values.
The geostatistical layer produced. This layer is required output only if no output raster is requested.
The output raster. This raster is required output only if no output geostatistical layer is requested.

The cell size at which the output raster will be created. This value can be explicitly set in the Environments by the Cell Size parameter. If not set, it is the shorter of the width or the height of the extent of the input point features, in the input spatial reference, divided by 250.

The exponent of distance that controls how quickly the weights decrease with distance. A higher power results in less influence from distant neighboring points. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. If no value is provided, a value will be estimated while the tool runs and displayed as a message. The estimated value will be the value that results in the lowest root-mean-square cross validation error.

Defines which surrounding points will be used to control the output. Standard is the default. Standard Major semiaxis—The major semiaxis value of the searching neighborhood. Minor semiaxis—The minor semiaxis value of the searching neighborhood. Angle—The angle of rotation for the axis (circle) or semimajor axis (ellipse) of the moving window. Max neighbors—The maximum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Min neighbors—The minimum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Sector Type—The geometry of the neighborhood. One sector—Single ellipse. Four sectors—Ellipse divided into four sectors. Four sectors shifted—Ellipse divided into four sectors and shifted 45 degrees. Eight sectors—Ellipse divided into eight sectors. Smooth Major semiaxis—The major semiaxis value of the searching neighborhood. Minor semiaxis—The minor semiaxis value of the searching neighborhood. Angle—The angle of rotation for the axis (circle) or semimajor axis (ellipse) of the moving window. Smoothing factor—The Smooth Interpolation option creates an outer ellipse and an inner ellipse at a distance equal to the Major Semiaxis multiplied by the Smoothing factor. The points that fall outside the smallest ellipse but inside the largest ellipse are weighted using a sigmoidal function with a value between zero and one. Standard Circular Radius—The length of the radius of the search circle. Angle—The angle of rotation for the axis (circle) or semimajor axis (ellipse) of the moving window. Max neighbors—The maximum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Min neighbors—The minimum number of neighbors that will be used to estimate the value at the unknown location. Sector Type—The geometry of the neighborhood. One sector—Single ellipse. Four sectors—Ellipse divided into four sectors. Four sectors shifted—Ellipse divided into four sectors and shifted 45 degrees. Eight sectors—Ellipse divided into eight sectors. Smooth Circular Radius—The length of the radius of the search circle. Smoothing factor—The Smooth Interpolation option creates an outer ellipse and an inner ellipse at a distance equal to the Major Semiaxis multiplied by the Smoothing factor. The points that fall outside the smallest ellipse but inside the largest ellipse are weighted using a sigmoidal function with a value between zero and one.

topic: 將項目添加至目錄資料集 (資料管理工具)
text:
此工具將從本地或網絡共享文件夾和工作空間添加項目。 要將活動門戶中的門戶項目添加到目錄資料集，請使用 將門戶項目添加至目錄資料集 工具。
指定目標目錄資料集后，可以應用過濾器以僅從由輸入項目參數值指定的工作空間添加某些項目類型。
添加至目錄資料集的項目必須為允許的項目類型。 當使用輸入項目參數指定一個或多個工作空間時，將僅從該工作空間添加允許的項目類型。
如果為輸入項目參數指定單個項目（例如 shapefile、.dwg 文件或圖徵類），則輸入項目類型參數值將不會阻止將這些項目包含在資料集中。
如果目錄資料集中已有某個項目，則不會重復添加。 所有被跳過的項目將顯示在工具消息中。
要將項目添加到在 ArcGIS Pro 3.1 中創建的目錄資料集中，必須使用 升級資料集 工具對資料集進行升級。
輸入項目參數支持地圖服務 URL 作為輸入。
無法將場景圖層包單獨指定為輸入項目參數值，但如果其位于指定的文件夾或工作空間中，則可以將其添加到資料集。
已添加到目錄資料集的項目必須具有范圍。
要從目錄資料集中刪除一個或多個項目，請打開資料集的屬性表并刪除記錄。

Specifies whether the contents of folders or workspaces specified in the Input Items parameter value will be recursively searched and added to the catalog dataset. Specifies whether the reference item's footprint will be the full extent or a convex hull representing the smallest convex polygon for all features. topic: 最大似然法分類的工作原理
section: 最大似然法分類的工作原理
text:
需具備 Spatial Analyst 許可方可使用。
最大似然法分類工具所用的算法基于兩條原則：
在多維空間中每個類樣本中的像元呈正態分布
貝葉斯決策理論
將各個像元指定給特征文件中所表示的一個類時，此工具會同時考慮類特征的平均值和協方差。 假設類樣本呈正態分布，則可使用均值向量和協方差矩陣作為類的特征。 如果給定了每個像元值的這兩個特征，則可計算每個類的統計概率，以確定像元作為該類的成員資格。 針對先驗概率權重指定默認的等于選項時，每個像元將被分配給它最有可能具有成員資格的類。
如果某些類出現的可能性大于（或小于）平均值，則應將文件先驗選項與輸入先驗概率文件結合使用。 具有特定概率的類的權重在先驗文件中指定。 這種情況下，先驗文件將有助于對處于兩個類的統計重疊內的像元進行分配。 這些像元將會更精確地分配給相應的類，從而獲得更理想的分類。 這種加權分類方法稱為貝葉斯分類器。
通過選擇先驗選項樣本，在輸入特征文件中進行采樣的所有類所分配到的先驗概率與按各個特征捕獲的像元數量成正比。 因此，像元數少于樣本平均值的類所獲得的權重將小于平均值，而像元數大于樣本平均值的類所獲得的權重將大于平均值。 因此，相應的類別被分配到的像元數量會更多或更少。
執行最大似然法分類時，還可同時生成一個可選的輸出置信網格。 此網格顯示分類置信度。 置信度的級數為 14，這與有效剔除分數值的個數直接相關。 置信網格中編碼為 1 的第一個置信度包含到輸入特征文件中所存儲的任何均值向量距離最短的像元，因此，這些像元的分類具有最高確定性。 只有在剔除分數為 0.99 或更小時，才會對第二個置信度所包含的像元（在置信網格中像元值為 2 ）進行分類。 在置信網格中，最低置信度級別的值為 14，顯示最有可能被錯誤分類的像元。 如果剔除分數為 0.005 或更大，將不對此置信度的像元進行分類。 如果未在特定置信度對像元進行分類，則輸出置信網格中將不顯示此置信度。

topic: 最大似然法分類的工作原理
text:
以下示例顯示了如何使用最大似然法分類工具將多波段網格監督分類為五個土地利用類。
分類的輸入多波段網格是俄亥俄州辛辛那提市北部地區的原始四波段 Landsat TM 衛星影像。
通過影像在圖徵類中定義了五個土地利用類以生成訓練樣本：Commercial/Industrial、Residential、Cropland、Forest 和 Pasture。 可以使用創建特征文件工具來計算類的統計資料以生成特征文件。
可使用最大似然法分類工具，通過輸入多波段網格和特征文件將網格像元分類到五個類中。
最大似然法分類工具對話框中使用的設置： 輸入網格波段：northerncincy.tif 輸入特征文件：signature.gsg 輸出多波段網格：landuse 剔除分數：0.0 先驗概率權重：EQUAL 輸入先驗概率文件：<blank> 輸出置信網格：confidence_ras
分類網格顯示如下：
還創建了一個輸出置信網格。 以下是針對置信網格生成的屬性表。 它顯示了按置信度等級分類的像元數。 值 1 表示正確分類的幾率至少為 0.995。 有 69 個像元是按該置信度進行分類的。 值 5 表示正確分類的幾率至少為 0.9，但低于 0.995。 有 744,128 個像元正確分類的幾率低于 0.005，其對應的值為 14。

text: 逐個像元地求出第一個網格資料除以第二個網格資料的余數(模)。

topic: 求模 (影像分析工具)
text:
使用此工具時輸入的順序很重要。
求模假設它的兩個輸入都是整數。 如果有任何輸入不是整數，則將通過截斷將這些輸入轉換為整數。 輸出值始終是整數。
任何被 0 求模（除）的值在輸出上均被賦予 NoData。 因此，在第二個輸入上值為 0 或 NoData 的任一位置在輸出上的對應位置都會返回 NoData。
如果第二個輸入值（除數）大于第一個輸入值（被除數），則輸出將與第一個輸入相同。 例如，如果要用值 8 除以值 10，則整數除法計算將返回輸入值 8 作為余數。
如果兩個輸入均為單波段網格，或者輸入之一是常量，則輸出將是單波段網格。
如果兩個輸入均為多波段網格，則該工具將針對一個輸入中的每個波段執行操作，并且輸出將為多波段網格。 每個多波段輸入中的波段數必須相同。
如果其中一個輸入為多波段網格，而另一個輸入為常量，則該工具將使用多波段輸入中每個波段的常量值執行運算，并且輸出將為多波段網格。
如果兩個輸入均為具有相同數量變量的多維網格資料，則該工具將對具有相同維度值的所有剖切片執行運算。 輸出將是 CRF 格式的多維網格。 輸入中的變量必須至少具有一個常見維度和一個常見維度值以供此工具進行處理，否則將發生錯誤。 如果兩個輸入均具有一個變量但名稱不同，請在運行工具之前取消選中匹配多維變量地理處理環境（在 Python 中設置 arcpy.env.matchMultidimensionalVariable = False）。 如果其中一個輸入為多維網格，而其他輸入為常量，則該工具將使用常量值，對所有變量的所有剖切片執行操作，并且輸出將為多維網格。
在地圖代數中，此工具的等價運算符符號為"%"（鏈接）。

topic: 提取 LAS (3D Analyst 工具)
text:
此工具可根據 LAS 資料集、點云 .slpk 文件或 I3S 點云場景圖層服務創建 .las 或 .zlas 文件。 當輸入為 LAS 資料集時，將為 LAS 資料集引用的每個 .las 或 .zlas 文件創建一個輸出文件。 當輸入為點云場景圖層時，輸出文件的數量將有所不同，具體取決于要提取的點的數量。 每個輸出文件的大小限制為約 1680 萬個點。 有些文件可能會超出此閾值或者點數較少。
可以對輸入點云進行過濾，以限制使用分類代碼、分類標簽和返回值的任意組合來提取的點。 通過將圖層加載到地圖或場景中，并在圖層屬性對話框中指定過濾器，可以定義點過濾器。 您也可以使用 創建 LAS 資料集圖層 工具將點過濾器應用于 LAS 資料集。 此外，可以通過指定處理范圍和提取邊界來提取輸入點云的子集。 當處理范圍具有提取邊界時，可以使用兩者的交集來創建輸出文件。 如果未定義處理范圍和提取邊界，則將對整個輸入點云進行處理。
除了按特定屬性過濾點外，您還可以使用 LAS 資料集圖層功能區過濾器組中的高程范圍控件按高程過濾 LAS 點。 此工具將支持在此控件上設置的高程范圍。
當輸入為 LAS 資料集時，生成的 LAS 文件版本和輸出的點記錄格式將與源文件相匹配。 當輸入為 I3S 點云場景圖層服務或者 .slpk 文件時，輸出將創建為 LAS 文件版本 1.4，但點記錄格式將取決于源點云的屬性，如下所示： 如果輸入不包含 RGB 或近紅外值，則將使用點格式 6。 如果輸入包含 RGB 值，但不包含近紅外值，則將使用點格式 7。 如果輸入包含 RGB 和近紅外值，則將使用點格式 8。 要使用不同的 LAS 文件版本和點記錄格式，請通過使用 轉換 LAS 工具對此工具的輸出文件進行處理來生成它們。
通常在 .las 文件中定義該文件的空間參考。 如果此信息缺失或不正確，則輔助 .prj 文件可以定義 LAS 文件的空間參考。 .prj 文件必須與 .las 文件位置相同，且其名稱必須與 .las 文件相同。 當 .prj 文件存在時，其將覆蓋 .las 文件中的空間參考信息。 可以為缺失或未正確定義空間參考的 .las 文件創建 .prj 文件，方法是針對各個 .las 或 .zlas 文件使用 定義投影 工具，或者使用 創建 LAS 資料集 工具的為 LAS 文件創建 PRJ 參數。

topic: 提取 LAS (3D Analyst 工具)
text:
通過指定 輸出座標系 環境設置，可以將輸入點云的水平座標系重新投影到不同的空間參考中。 此外，通過確保通過垂直座標系定義垂直單位，即可實現 z 單位轉換。 但是，目前不支持垂直基準面變換。 確保任何水平座標系轉換都能夠保留原始垂直座標系。
LAS 點記錄以不符合點空間聚類的二進制序列存儲在 .las 文件中并不罕見。 查詢此類資料分布時，訪問代表 LAS 點的二進制記錄的效率會有所降低。 在生成的 .las 文件中重新排列點可優化資料以供可視化及其他空間操作。 啟用重新排列選項后，將自動計算統計資料。 如果您不重新排列 LAS 點，則可以啟用或禁用計算統計資料。 計算統計資料可優化空間查詢并對 .las 文件中存在的類代碼和返回值提供匯總信息。 但是，這也會增加工具的處理時間。 如果不在 ArcGIS 中使用生成的 .las 文件，則可以禁用計算統計資料，以便加快工具的處理速度。
可以使用提取邊界參數將輸入點云裁剪為不規則形狀。 此參數支持用于定義連續研究區域的面邊界，例如覆蓋相對較大區域的單個面圖徵。 雖然可以提供表示鄰近感興趣區域的多個面作為輸入，但是邊界圖徵不支持表示大量較小圖徵（例如樹木或建筑物）的面。 可以合并多個面以有效地裁剪輸入點云。 因此，請避免指定具有許多較小的面的邊界圖徵，這將導致性能下降。

values: 將評估的資料范圍。 當前顯示范圍 - 范圍基于活動地圖或場景。 繪制范圍 - 范圍將基于在地圖或場景上繪制的矩形。 圖層范圍 - 范圍基于活動地圖圖層。 選擇可用圖層或者使用所有圖層中的資料范圍選項。 每個地圖圖層具有以下選項： 所有圖徵 - 所有圖徵的范圍。 選定圖徵 - 選定圖徵的范圍。 可見圖徵 - 可見圖徵的范圍。 瀏覽 - 范圍將基于資料集。 輸入的交集 - 范圍將為所有輸入的相交范圍。 輸入的并集 - 范圍將為所有輸入的合并范圍。 剪貼板 - 可在剪貼板中復制和粘貼范圍。 復制范圍 - 將范圍座標和座標系復制到剪貼板。 粘貼范圍 - 從剪貼板粘貼范圍和座標系。 如果剪貼板不包含座標系，則范圍將使用地圖的座標系。 重置范圍 - 將范圍重置為默認值。 當手動提供座標時，座標必須為數值，并且位于活動地圖的座標系中。 地圖可能使用與提供的座標不同的顯示單位。 在南緯和西經座標中使用負號。

ExtractLas 示例 2（獨立腳本）
下面的示例演示了如何在獨立 Python 腳本中使用此工具：

topic: 提取 LAS (3D Analyst 工具)
text:
'''****************************************************************************
Name: Split Large LAS File
Description: Divides a large LAS file whose point distribution covers the full
             XY extent of the data into smaller files to optimize performance
             when reading lidar data.
****************************************************************************'''
# Import system modules
import arcpy
import tempfile
import math

in_las_file = arcpy.GetParameterAsText(0)
tile_width = arcpy.GetParameter(1) # double in LAS file's XY linear unit
tile_height = arcpy.GetParameter(2) # double in LAS file's XY linear unit
out_folder = arcpy.GetParameterAsText(3) # folder for LAS files
out_name_suffix = arcpy.GetParameterAsText(4) # basename for output files
out_lasd = arcpy.GetParameterAsText(5) # output LAS dataset

try:
    temp_lasd = arcpy.CreateUniqueName('temp.lasd', tempfile.gettempdir())
    arcpy.management.CreateLasDataset(in_las_file, temp_lasd,
                                      compute_stats='COMPUTE_STATS')
    desc = arcpy.Describe(temp_lasd)
    total_columns = int(math.ceil(desc.extent.width/tile_width))
    total_rows = int(math.ceil(desc.extent.height/tile_height))
    digits = int(math.log10(max(cols, rows))) + 1
    for row in range(1, total_rows+1):
        yMin = desc.extent.YMin + tile_height*(row-1)
        yMax = desc.extent.YMin + tile_height*(row)
        for col in range (1, total_columns+1):
            xMin = desc.extent.XMin + tile_width*(col-1)
            xMax = desc.extent.XMax + tile_width*(col)
            name_suffix = '_{0}_{1}x{2}'.format(out_name_suffix,
                                                str(row).zfill(digits),
                                                str(col).zfill(digits))
            arcpy.ddd.ExtractLas(temp_lasd, out_folder,
                                 arcpy.Extent(xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax),
                                 name_suffix=name_suffix,
                                 rearrange_points='REARRANGE_POINTS',
                                 compute_stats='COMPUTE_STATS')
    arcpy.env.workspace = out_folder
    arcpy.management.CreateLasDataset(arcpy.ListFiles('*{0}*.las'.format(out_name_suffix)),
                                      out_lasd, compute_stats='COMPUTE_STATS',
                                      relative_paths='RELATIVE_PATHS')
except arcpy.ExecuteError:
    print(arcpy.GetMessages())

topic: 提取 LAS (3D Analyst 工具)
steps: 開啟 Analysis > Tools，以英文名稱搜尋 Extract LAS，核對工具箱及工具摘要。

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸入點云 [in_las_dataset]、目標文件夾 [target_folder]、處理范圍 （可選） [extent]、提取邊界 （可選） [boundary]、處理與范圍相交的整個 LAS 文件 （可選） [process_entire_files]、輸出文件名后綴 （可選） [name_suffix]、移除變量長度記錄 （可選） [remove_vlr]、重新排列點 （可選） [rearrange_points]、計算統計資料 （可選） [compute_stats]、輸出 LAS 資料集 （可選） [out_las_dataset]、壓縮 （可選） [compression]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

topic: 提取 LAS (3D Analyst 工具)
section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.datatype: LAS Dataset Layer; Scene Layer; File
parameters.description_en: The LAS dataset, point cloud scene layer package (.slpk file), or I3S point cloud service that will be extracted. An I3S point cloud service must have the export property enabled to be processed.
The existing folder where the output LAS format files will be written.

The extent of the data that will be evaluated. Current Display Extent —The extent will be based on the active map or scene. Draw Extent —The extent will be based on a rectangle drawn on the map or scene. Extent of a Layer —The extent will be based on an active map layer. Choose an available layer or use the Extent of data in all layers option. Each map layer has the following options: All Features —The extent of all features. Selected Features —The extent of the selected features. Visible Features —The extent of visible features. Browse —The extent will be based on a dataset. Intersection of Inputs —The extent will be the intersecting extent of all inputs. Union of Inputs —The extent will be the combined extent of all inputs. Clipboard —The extent can be copied to and from the clipboard. Copy Extent —Copies the extent and coordinate system to the clipboard. Paste Extent —Pastes the extent and coordinate system from the clipboard. If the clipboard does not include a coordinate system, the extent will use the map's coordinate system. Reset Extent —The extent will be reset to the default value. When coordinates are manually provided, the coordinates must be numeric values and in the active map's coordinate system. The map may use different display units than the provided coordinates. Use a negative value sign for south and west coordinates.

A polygon boundary that will be used to clip the input point cloud. This boundary should represent a primary study area that is typically defined by one contiguous polygon, but it can also be composed of more than one polygon when it represents a common study area with a relevant spatial gap.

parameters.label_zh: 處理與范圍相交的整個 LAS 文件 （可選）
parameters.label_en: Process entire LAS files that intersect extent (Optional)
parameters.description_en: Specifies how the processing extent will be applied. Checked—If any portion of a .las file intersects the area of interest, all the points in that file, including those outside the area of interest, will be processed. Unchecked—Only LAS points that intersect the area of interest will be processed. This is the default.
The text that will be appended to the name of each output .las file. Each file will inherit its base name from its source file, followed by the suffix provided in this parameter.

parameters.label_zh: 移除變量長度記錄 （可選）
parameters.description_en: Specifies whether variable length records (VLRs) will be removed. Each .las file may contain a set of VLRs that were added by the software that produced it. The meaning of these records is typically only known by the originating software. Unless the output LAS data will be processed by an application that understands this information, retaining the VLRs may not provide any value-added functionality. Removing the VLRs may save significant disk space depending on their total size and the number of files containing them. Checked—The additional variable length records will be removed from the .las files. Unchecked—Any data stored in the processed .las file's variable length records will not be removed and will remain in the extracted files. This is the default.

Specifies whether points in the .las or .zlas files will be rearranged to optimize the performance of reading and updating the classification of the point cloud. Checked—The order of points will be rearranged into spatial clusters that optimize reading the data. Rearranged points can improve the performance of subsequent operations that are performed on the point cloud. This is the default. Unchecked—The order of points will not be rearranged.

Specifies whether statistics will be computed for the .las files referenced by the LAS dataset. Computing statistics provides a spatial index for each .las file, which improves analysis and display performance. Statistics also enhance the filtering and symbology experience by limiting the display of LAS attributes, such as classification codes and return information, to values that are present in the .las file. Checked—Statistics will be computed. This is the default. Unchecked—Statistics will not be computed.

parameters.label_zh: 輸出 LAS 資料集 （可選）
parameters.description_en: The output LAS dataset referencing the newly created .las files.

Specifies whether the output .las file will be in a compressed format or the standard LAS format. Same As Input—The compression will be the same as the input. This option is only available when the input is a LAS dataset, and it is the default in that case. No Compression—The output will be in the standard LAS format (*.las file). This is the default when the input is a point cloud scene layer. zLAS Compression—Output .las files will be compressed in the zLAS format.

Specifies whether the LAS dataset will reference its source files using relative or absolute paths. Relative paths may be convenient when the LAS dataset and its associated data will be relocated in the file system using the same relative location. Checked—Relative paths will be used for the data referenced by the LAS dataset. Unchecked—Absolute paths will be used for the data referenced by the LAS dataset. This is the default.

topic: 簡化線 (制圖工具)
text:
此工具為不同目的使用不同的簡化算法。 要了解有關這些算法的詳細信息，請參閱簡化線和簡化面的工作原理。 簡化算法參數的選項如下所示。 **保留關鍵點（道格拉斯-普克）**算法（Python 中的 "POINT_REMOVE"）可以標識并移除相對多余的折點來簡化資料并以較小的比例顯示。 這是此工具中最快的簡化算法選項。 此選項通常用于資料壓縮或粗糙的簡化。 隨著容差的增大，生成的線中有棱角的部分將顯著增加。 保留關鍵折彎 (Wang-Müller) 算法（Python 中的 "BEND_SIMPLIFY"）可以標識并消除相對不太重要的折彎來簡化資料并以較小的比例顯示。 相比于**保留關鍵點（道格拉斯-普克）**選項，通常這種算法生成的結果更接近輸入幾何，但可能需要更多的處理時間。 保留加權有效面積 (Zhou-Jones) 算法（Python 中的 "WEIGHTED_AREA"）可以標識每個折點有效面積的三角形。 隨后采用一系列度量對這些三角形進行加權以對比每個面積的平面度、偏度和凸度。 通過加權后的面積指導移除相應折點以簡化線，同時盡可能多地保留特性。 保留有效面積 (Visvalingam-Whyatt) 算法（Python 中的 "EFFECTIVE_AREA"）可通過標識每個折點的有效三角形面積來指導移除折點以簡化線，同時盡可能多地保留特性。
簡化容差參數值用于確定簡化程度。 容差越大，則生成的幾何越粗糙。 較小的容差可生成更加精確地表示輸入的幾何。 將 MinSimpTol 和 MaxSimpTol 欄位添加至輸出以存儲使用過的容差。 舊版本： 在拓撲解析過程中，ArcGIS Pro 1.4 之前版本的工具針對每個圖徵修改了容差，并將這些值存儲在 MinSimpTol 和 MaxSimpTol 欄位中。 現在，這些欄位中的值將相同，并等于在簡化容差參數中指定的容差。 請確保根據這些欄位修改現有模型和腳本。 對于**保留關鍵點（道格拉斯-普克）**算法，容差表示每個折點與新創建的線之間的最大允許垂直距離。 對于保留關鍵折彎 (Wang-Müller) 算法，容差是近似于有效折彎的圓的直徑。 對于保留加權有效面積 (Zhou-Jones) 算法，容差的平方是由三個相鄰折點定義的有效三角形的面積。 三角形越偏離等邊三角形，則它的重量越大，被移除的可能性越小。 對于保留有效面積 (Visvalingam-Whyatt) 算法，容差的平方是由三個相鄰折點定義的有效三角形的面積。

topic: 簡化線 (制圖工具)
text:
可以使用保留折疊的點參數來創建一個輸出點圖徵類，以存儲小于資料空間容差的所有線的端點。 已派生點輸出；將使用與輸出圖徵類參數相同的名稱和位置，但帶有 _Pnt 后綴。 輸出線圖徵類包含輸入圖徵類中的所有欄位。 輸出點圖徵類將不包含這些欄位。
在簡化幾何時，可能會產生拓撲錯誤，例如圖徵之間的自相交和重疊。 處理拓撲錯誤參數具有三個選項，用于確定在這些情況下會發生什么： 不檢查拓撲錯誤—將不會標識拓撲錯誤。 處理過程會更快。 如果您能夠保證資料的拓撲精度，請使用此選項。 標記拓撲錯誤—將標識并標記拓撲錯誤。 輸出圖徵類將包含 InLine_FID 和 SimLnFlag 欄位。 InLine_FID 欄位將包含輸入圖徵 ID。 如果存在拓撲錯誤，則 SimLnFlag 欄位將包含值 1；如果不存在任何錯誤，則該欄位將包含值 0（零）。 解決拓撲錯誤—將不會在輸出中創建拓撲錯誤，并且輸入中存在的錯誤將在交叉點處插入折點。 將保留圖徵之間的現有拓撲關系，例如共享邊。 處理時間會較長。 輸出圖徵類將包含 InLine_FID 和 SimLnFlag 欄位。 InLine_FID 欄位將包含輸入圖徵 ID。 如果輸入中存在拓撲錯誤，則 SimLnFlag 欄位將包含值 1，如果不存在錯誤，則包含值 0（零）。 舊版本： 在 ArcGIS Pro 1.4 之前的版本中，該工具使用了檢查拓撲錯誤和解決拓撲錯誤參數來處理拓撲錯誤。 為了腳本和模型的兼容性，工具語法中仍然包含這些參數，但現已忽略這些參數并將其從地理處理窗格中隱藏。 SimLnFlag 欄位用來標記工具在處理過程中引入的拓撲錯誤。 此欄位用于標識輸入中存在的錯誤。
使用輸入障礙圖層參數來標識簡化線不得越過的圖徵。 障礙圖徵可以是點、線或面。
即使未選中傳送地理資料庫欄位屬性 環境，也會將屬性域和子類型復制到輸出。
處理大型資料集可能會超出內存限制。 在這種情況下，考慮通過在制圖分區 環境設置中確定一個相關的面圖徵類來通過分區處理輸入資料。 將按順序處理分區邊界定義的資料部分。 生成的圖徵類無縫，而且在分區邊界一致。 有關詳細信息，請參閱使用分區概化大型資料集。 注意： 將處理拓撲錯誤參數設置為不檢查拓撲錯誤或標記拓撲錯誤時，將忽略制圖分區環境設置。

text:
SimplifyLine 示例 2（獨立腳本）
以下獨立腳本演示了如何使用 SimplifyLine 函數。

topic: 簡化線 (制圖工具)
text:
# Name: SimplifyLine_Example2.py
# Description: Simplify line features from two feature classes, rivers and coastlines,
# while maintaining their connections

# Import system modules
import arcpy

# Set environment settings
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/data/Portland.gdb/Hydrography"

# Set local variables
inRiverFeatures = "rivers"
inCoastlineFeatures = "coastlines"

mergedFeatures = "C:/data/PortlandOutput.gdb/merged_lines"
simplifiedFeatures = "C:/data/PortlandOutput.gdb/merged_lines_simplified"
tempLayer = "tempLyr"

outRiverFeatureClass = "C:/data/PortlandOutput.gdb/rivers_final"
outCoastlineFeatureClass = "C:/data/PortlandOutput.gdb/coastlines_final"

# Merge rivers and coastlines into one feature class,
# assuming that they have a common f-code field
# with value 40 for rivers and 80 for coastlines.
arcpy.management.Merge(inRiverFeatures, inCoastlineFeatures, mergedFeatures)

# Simplify all lines.
arcpy.cartography.SimplifyLine(mergedFeatures,
                simplifiedFeatures,
                "BEND_SIMPLIFY",
                100,
                "KEEP_COLLAPSED_POINTS")

# Select rivers and coastlines by their f-code values
# and put them in separate feature classes.
arcpy.management.MakeFeatureLayer(simplifiedFeatures, tempLayer, "f-code = 40")
arcpy.management.CopyFeatures(tempLayer, outRiverFeatureClass)

arcpy.management.MakeFeatureLayer(simplifiedFeatures, tempLayer, "f-code = 80")
arcpy.management.CopyFeatures(tempLayer, outCoastlineFeatureClass)

依工具窗格順序核對下列參數；展開同頁的參數卡可查說明、選項與資料型別。輸入圖徵 [in_features]、輸出圖徵類 [out_feature_class]、簡化算法 [algorithm]、簡化容差 [tolerance]、解決拓撲錯誤 （可選） [error_resolving_option]、保留折疊的點 （可選） [collapsed_point_option]、檢查拓撲錯誤 （可選） [error_checking_option]、輸入障礙圖層 （可選） [in_barriers]、處理拓撲錯誤 （可選） [error_option]
依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。

parameters.description_en: The input line features that will be simplified.

The simplified output line feature class. It will contain all the fields from the input feature class. The output line feature class is topologically correct. The tool does not introduce topology errors, but topological errors in the input data will be flagged in the output line feature class. The output feature class will include the InLine_FID and SimLnFlag fields to contain the input feature IDs and the input topological errors, respectively. A SimLnFlag value of 1 indicates that an input topological error is present; a value of 0 (zero) indicates that no input error is present.

Specifies the line simplification algorithm that will be used. Retain critical points (Douglas-Peucker)—Critical points that preserve the essential shape of a line will be retained, and all other points will be removed (Douglas-Peucker). This is the default. Retain critical bends (Wang-Müller)—Critical bends will be retained, and extraneous bends will be removed from a line (Wang-Müller). Retain weighted effective areas (Zhou-Jones)—Vertices that form triangles of effective area that have been weighted by triangle shape will be retained (Zhou-Jones). Retain effective areas (Visvalingam-Whyatt)—Vertices that form triangles of effective area will be retained (Visvalingam-Whyatt).

The degree of simplification that will be used. You can choose a preferred unit; otherwise, the units of the input will be used. The MinSimpTol and MaxSimpTol fields will be added to the output to store the tolerance that was used when processing occurred. For the Retain critical points (Douglas-Peucker) algorithm, the tolerance is the maximum allowable perpendicular distance between each vertex and the newly created line . For the Retain critical bends (Wang-Müller) algorithm, the tolerance is the diameter of a circle that approximates a significant bend. For the Retain weighted effective areas (Zhou-Jones) algorithm, the square of the tolerance is the area of a significant triangle defined by three adjacent vertices. The further a triangle deviates from equilateral, the higher weight it is given, and the less likely it is to be removed. For the Retain effective areas (Visvalingam-Whyatt) algorithm, the square of the tolerance is the area of a significant triangle defined by three adjacent vertices.

Legacy: This is a legacy parameter that is no longer used. It was formerly used to indicate how topological errors, possibly introduced during processing, were resolved. This parameter is still included in the tool's syntax for compatibility in scripts and models but is hidden from the Geoprocessing pane.

Specifies whether an output point feature class will be created to store the endpoints of lines that are smaller than the spatial tolerance. The point output is derived; it will use the same name and location as the Output Feature Class parameter value but with a _Pnt suffix. Checked—A derived output point feature class will be created to store the endpoints of collapsed zero length lines. This is the default. Unchecked—A derived output point feature class will not be created.

Note: This is a legacy parameter that is no longer used. It was formerly used to indicate how topological errors, possibly introduced during processing, were handled. This parameter is still included in the tool's syntax for compatibility in scripts and models but is hidden from the Geoprocessing pane.

Inputs containing features to act as barriers for simplification. Resulting simplified lines will not touch or cross barrier features. For example, when simplifying contour lines, spot height features input as barriers ensure that the simplified contour lines will not simplify across these points. The output will not violate the elevation as described by measured spot heights.

Specifies how topological errors will be handled. Topological errors may be introduced in the simplification process and can include lines crossing or overlapping lines. Do not check for topological errors—Topological errors will not be identified. This is the default. Flag topological errors—Topological errors will be flagged. Resolve topological errors—Topological errors will be resolved.

#save output
classifiedraster.save("c:/test/moncton_classified.tif")
